body_markdown:
Features


November 26, 2026


# Vesence now works with Google


You can now sign in with Google and connect Gmail, Google Drive and Google Calendar to Vesence. Your mail, files and calendar are in one place, and you can hand off work to agents across all of them.


Until now, Vesence worked with Microsoft 365. Now it works with Google Workspace too, and the two sit side by side: one Mail and one Calendar for both.


Each service connects on its own, so you choose what Vesence can reach. Signing in with Google does not by itself give access to your mail, files or calendar.


## 01


Gmail


Draft a reply from your inbox


Gmail opens in Mail with your labels, inbox tabs and conversations as you know them. Read, search and reply, and attach files from your drives or from Google Drive.


Ask for a reply and it is written as a real Gmail draft, with the thread and its attachments in place. Nothing is sent. The draft waits for you, and you press Send.


## 02


Google Drive


Google Drive, right here in Files


My Drive, your shared drives and what others share with you appear in Files, next to your Vesence drives. Upload, move and rename as usual, or copy files between the two.


Agents can search across file names and contents, and point you to the exact paragraph or cell they found.


## 03


Google Docs, Sheets and Slides


Edit in Drive, every change tracked


Google Docs, Sheets and Slides open in Vesence’s own editors, next to the Word, Excel and PowerPoint files you keep in Drive.


When an agent edits a document, each change is tracked, so you can accept or reject it. Nothing changes in Drive until you publish, and the file keeps its link and sharing.


## 04


Google Calendar


Approve it, and it’s on your calendar


Your Google calendars show in Calendar, together with Microsoft 365 if you use both. Create events, invite people, add a Google Meet link and see when everyone is free.


Ask for a meeting and the invitation is prepared for you to review. It goes out only when you send it.


## 05


Google AI subscription


Bring your Google AI subscription


Sign in with your Google account and use your Google AI subscription in the chat, next to Claude Code and Codex.


Gemini runs on your own plan and works on your Vesence computer, next to your documents, mail and files.


## 06


Approvals and privacy


You keep the final say


Changes an agent makes in Gmail, Drive or Calendar wait for your approval. For routine ones you can choose not to be asked again. Deletions and invitations always ask, and agents cannot send email.


Vesence never receives your Google password, and access is stored encrypted. Your Google data is not sold, used for advertising or used to train general AI models, as our[Privacy Notice](https://www.vesence.com/legal/privacy) sets out. You can disconnect at any time in Settings.


## Questions
and answers


Which Google services does Vesence work with?Gmail, Google Drive and Google Calendar, and you can sign in to Vesence with your Google account. Google Docs, Sheets and Slides kept in Drive open in Vesence’s own editors. Each service is connected on its own in Settings, under Permissions.


Can I use Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 together in Vesence?Yes. Both can be connected at the same time. Mail shows your Gmail and Outlook mailboxes, and Calendar shows your Google and Microsoft 365 calendars together.


Can an agent in Vesence send email from my Gmail account?No. An agent can read and search your mail and write drafts, which are saved to your Gmail drafts. Only you can send them.


Does anything change in my Google account without my approval?Changes an agent makes in Gmail, Google Drive or Google Calendar wait for your approval. You can choose not to be asked again for routine changes, such as saving a draft. Deleting something and sending a calendar invitation always ask.


How does Vesence handle my Google data?Vesence never receives your Google password, and access tokens are stored encrypted. Vesence follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements: your Google data is not sold, used for advertising or used to train general AI models. Disconnecting in Settings deletes the stored tokens and revokes Vesence’s access at Google.


How do I get started with Google in Vesence?If you already use Vesence, open Settings, go to Permissions and connect Gmail, Google Drive and Google Calendar. Vesence is by invitation: to join, request an invite or book a demo at vesence.com.


Sign in with Google, connect what you need, and hand off the work.


Connect Gmail, Google Drive and Google Calendar in Settings, under Permissions. New to Vesence?[Request an invite](https://www.vesence.com/request-invite) .
